claims.claim: A maximal-rank direction of a real symmetric pencil has kernel isotropic for every coefficient matrix; highest determinant degree is tested by the generic kernel compression.
claims.scope: Finite symmetric matrices over the reals; algebraic compression identity also works in characteristic zero.
claims.novelty: An explicit criterion for the source's determinant-degree question; no general linear-algebra priority claim.

claims.claim: For an eventually one-sign real discrete moment weight, at most r(r-rho) integer cutoffs beyond its sign threshold have determinant degree smaller than generic pencil rank.
claims.scope: A fixed real symmetric coefficient pencil and the stated finite-moment decomposition.
claims.novelty: New result relative to the inspected incoming report; independent literature priority not asserted.

claims.claim: Every nonzero real rational weight has harmonic degree exactly equal to generic pencil rank over the rational cutoff field.
claims.scope: No poles at nonnegative integer sample nodes; complex conjugate partial fractions are realified. Arbitrary complex weights are not covered.
claims.source_question: Finite Difference Determinants, Further research questions, When does determinant degree equal harmonic rank?

claims.claim: The shortened-stencil family realizes every harmonic rank 1 through r with common critical decay n^(-(2r-1)), and has exactly one highest-degree harmonic monomial.
claims.scope: Integer r>=2, 1<=rho<=r; positive-real shift for positivity and nonvanishing.
claims.novelty: Extension of the predecessor's rho=1 finite-difference family; not a minimal functional-depth theorem.

claims.claim: The spectral hierarchy has exact pole order rho-m+1 at every m=1,...,rho and an explicit leading Laurent coefficient.
claims.scope: Initial absolute convergence Re(s)>rho, Re(a)>0; exact nonvanishing for real a>0.
claims.novelty: New spectral hierarchy relative to the inspected source; does not resolve general Gauss-ensemble resonances.

claims.status: proved using a classical determinant evaluation
claims.claim: The highest-order spectral pole has a finite Gamma-product leading coefficient.
claims.scope: The lower-particle Gamma-weight moment determinant, including the empty determinant.
claims.novelty: The product evaluation is classical; its normalization and role in this spectral hierarchy are derived explicitly.

claims.claim: The two-particle shortened-stencil spectrum has an explicit zeta-product evaluation and explicit generalized-Stieltjes/polygamma spectral finite parts.
claims.scope: Ordinary ensemble for Re(s)>2; meromorphic continuation and Laurent finite parts elsewhere.
claims.novelty: Concrete consequences of the hierarchy; no claim of new relations among independent zeta or Stieltjes constants.

claims.claim: The first-difference rank-two cutoff determinant has an explicit one-direction multiple-polylogarithm generator and anchored Euler primitive.
claims.scope: Absolute and locally normal convergence for |z|<1, with removable zero values specified.
claims.novelty: A consequence of the new hierarchy, distinct from the inspected predecessor's second-difference generator; no minimal-depth claim.

claims.scope: The new determinant cutoff family at r=rho=2,a=1; all component series are absolutely convergent.
claims.novelty: The determinant endpoint is a new consequence relative to the inspected material; the weight-six MZV inputs are classical and explicitly reduced.

verification.independent_audit: The degree and spectral sections were independently audited by the moment-rank collaborator; root independently checked the later polylogarithm generator, primitive and endpoint algebra. No correction was identified.
verification.limitations: Scripts are diagnostics, not formal proofs or certified numerical enclosures.
